call_goal: Understand how Fernhollow Insurance decides a claims-assistant change is ready to ship, and who makes that call
desired_outcomes: Know who makes the call to ship (still open)

transcript.text: How do you decide a new prompt version is good enough to ship, and who makes that call?

So we have a regression set, about two hundred real claim questions with reference answers. We run the new version against it, compare the scores with the current one, and then someone reads through the ones that changed. If nothing got worse, it goes out, usually on a Tuesday.
Yeah, that's been the routine since spring.
